messages.content:
csvsummary miscounts our support exports. Ticket comments in those exports are quoted
and often span several lines, and csvsummary treats every line break inside a comment
as the start of a new row. examples/support-2026-10.csv is a piece of the October
export: it has 6 tickets, but csvsummary summary reports 10 rows, the ticket column
loses its min, max, and mean, and csvsummary top on the status column lists 4 empty
statuses that are not in the file.

Please fix how files are read:

- a quoted field that contains line breaks is one value of one row, so csvsummary
  summary counts that row once and every column's counts and numbers come out right,
  and csvsummary top counts the values of every column correctly;
- csvsummary top should show a value that contains line breaks the way
  docs/FORMAT.md says listings show them;
- the error for a row with too many fields should name the line on which that row
  starts, also when that row or an earlier one contains line breaks, and the command
  should still exit with status 2.

Files without quoted line breaks should give exactly the same output as today,
including how short rows, blank lines, and --delimiter are handled.
